items.t: Engine failure from leftover machining debris (recall)
items.note: Lexus replaces the engine for free. The 2024 expansion's remedy was still being developed.

items.t: SUV can roll when left in neutral (recall)
Transmission shift solenoid failure can cause over-revving and power loss (recall)
Backup camera image freezes or goes blank (recall)
Stability control may stay off after restart (recall)
Passenger airbags can switch off from broken seat belt sensor wire (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace front passenger seat belt assembly (recall 18V-887)

items.t: Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal and floor mat (recall 11V-113)

items.t: Wrong airbag may be installed (recall)
Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
Water pump leaks coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: One owner paid $250 at a dealer; a coolant change alone runs about $470-$580.

items.t: Hard starting and check engine light for lean codes
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $1,500-$1,700 for an LX 570 fuel pump ($1,750-$2,780 at shops); hours are estimated from its labor figure because the bulletin points to the flat-rate manual. The bulletin covers 2014-2020 LX 570s; the 6-year/70,000-mile powertrain warranty applies if your SUV is still inside it.

items.t: Front brakes squeal at low speed
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors with the updated Lexus rotors
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $600-$700 for front rotors on a 2010-2019 LX 570 ($820-$1,210 at shops). Built from YourMechanic's figures.

items.t: Harsh downshift or check engine light with transmission codes
items.note: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0127-12 lists 0.4 hours to reprogram the ECM for the harsh 2-1 downshift on 2008-2011 LX 570. If transmission codes are stored, diagnosis may add time.

items.t: Rear air conditioning leaks or stops cooling
items.job: Repair rear A/C refrigerant lines and recharge
items.note: Owners report $1,600 for rear line leaks and $2,000 for a rear A/C failure.

items.t: Navigation screen turns pink, purple or black
items.note: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0094-16 lists 0.3 hours for the navigation software update from a USB drive on 2016-2020 LX 570.

items.t: Musty smell from the vents
items.job: Replace cabin air filter and clean the A/C evaporator
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $186-$226 for the cabin filter alone on an LX 570 ($199-$305 at shops). Finding a water leak or clearing a blocked drain costs extra.

items.t: Height control (AHC) suspension sags or shows fault light
items.job: Replace AHC accumulators (globes) and service fluid
items.note: Owners report about $300-$800; used globes cost less.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold ticking
items.job: Replace one exhaust manifold and gaskets
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,940-$2,580 on an LX 470. An owner cites a book time of about 7 hours per side; the parts figure is backed out of RepairPal's total. Welding a crack can cost less; broken studs add time.

items.t: Click but no crank from worn starter
items.note: RepairPal lists $1,157-$1,428 for a 1998 LX 470 and YourMechanic about $1,150-$1,250 for most years. An owner reports about $1,100 in labor alone. Chilton lists 5.0 hours for the similar Lexus LS 400 V8 starter. Replacing only the starter contacts costs less in parts.

items.t: Gas pedal stops responding
items.note: One owner paid close to $600 at a dealer.

items.t: Inner CV axle boot leaks grease
items.job: Replace front CV axle (or reboot the inner joint)
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $516-$552 for a front CV axle on an LX 470 ($600-$920 at shops); built from YourMechanic's figures because no book time was found. Rebooting alone costs less if the joint is still clean.

items.t: Rear axle oil leak soaks rear brakes
items.job: Reseal rear axle and replace oil-soaked rear brake parts

items.t: ABS brake actuator failure
items.note: One owner was quoted $2,000 by a dealer and paid $800 using a refurbished unit.

items.t: Steering shaft can disconnect after hard impact (recall)
items.job: Install redesigned snap ring and retainer (recall 10V-346)

items.t: Side curtain airbags can deploy unexpectedly (recall)
Front axle knuckle seals leak
items.job: Rebuild both front axle knuckles (seals, bearings and gaskets)
items.note: A knuckle rebuild kit is about $125, plus about $100 for bearings; owners say OEM parts cost 2-3 times more. Owners estimate about 8 hours of labor, and one shop quoted $2,900. Worn birfield joints or axles add more.

items.t: Oil leaks from valve cover and oil pan gaskets
items.note: RepairPal lists $264-$355 for an LX 570 valve cover gasket; an oil pan gasket on the LX 450 adds more.

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensors
items.note: Owners report $270 for one sensor and about $400 with an exhaust pipe; two catalytic converters ran about $740.
